mentions.name: The Lab Company
mentions.description: A professional network for upskilling. The MVP guides users on fun projects to build that also incorporate cutting-edge skills, using RAG combined with memory of user feedback to tailor project recommendations. An earlier experiment using an LLM to build a skill graph of AI skills from git was abandoned in favor of the simpler approach.
mentions.source_excerpt: I am working on the MVP for https://www.thelabcompany.co/ the professional network for Upskilling. Solo founder. Experimented with asking LLM for a skill graph of AI skills from git. That went nowhere. Now looking to do something simpler - RAG + memory of user feedback to guide the user on fun projects to build that also include cutting edge skills.
